As you walk up the chic staircase, you will find 3 spacious and stylish all en-suite bedrooms, separate pyjama lounge, master suite comprising well sized closet space and spectacular bathroom design.

A combination of flawless design, textures and true quality makes this the perfect acquisition.

I welcome you to an exclusive viewing.

This home ticks all the boxes such as usable space, high end quality finishes all at a price point which is extremely affordable for many to enter.

A signature product around the perfect blend of features, layout and square meterage to give you both fantastic indoor and outdoor space.

Lower level: open plan living space stacking onto your patio and large garden which is pet friendly, ultra modern kitchen, 2 large bedrooms, modern full bathroom, storage room, interleading garages.

Upper level: upstairs lounge and balcony, massive main bedroom with open plan bathroom with a great amount of cupboard space.
